doc: Cross-check of 01 table B, assault squad row (1 rifle at 40 m, 4 shotguns at 15 m) against an unarmed dummy, on the core package. Four placements, as the table ran them: hold at 12 m (x 73); move to the dummy's centre from 60 m; attack-move from 60 m (base); attack from 44 m. The attack variant's order is `unchecked`: the table's runs set orders without the sight check, and the assault squad does not see the dummy at 44 m at turn start, so the check would refuse it. Expectations are table B's DPS1 (6.7, 8.8, 2.0, 2.2) within 5%. Re-pinned by sw-txnj.5 (A3, per-unit firing positions): attack-move and attack now walk the short weapons in. The B3 target (attack-move at least 0.9 of hold at 12 m) is mixed_range_orders, pending.

attack.doc: Attack the dummy from 44 m (unchecked, see the doc).
